claude.performance_metric: $17.5M full goodwill impairment of Patch (Q3 2013); majority interest divested Jan 2014, brand shuttered
claude.rationale: p4_pathway=1: the slice documents a realized product/process breakdown — a prominently invested closing-era local-content property (Patch) "could not be sustained on the platform," was fully goodwill-impaired ($17.5M, Q3 2013), had its majority interest divested (January 2014), and was among brands shuttered/disposed in 2014 with associated long-lived-asset impairments. p5_pathway=uncertain: the slice references lower headcount related to Patch but documents no specific fracture at the operations/organization (people/management/culture) interface, so this cannot be determined. t2_model=0: no documented incompatibility of value-capture logics; revenues grew and the ad-tech model consolidated under "AOL Platforms." t1_archetype=uncertain: the slice contains no closing-era intent framing to assess against the realized record.

grok.performance_metric: Patch majority divested after $17.5M goodwill impairment; AOL sold to Verizon at $50/share
grok.rationale: p4_pathway=1 is driven by the documented product-process failure of Patch: Q3 2013 step-two goodwill evaluation fully impaired Patch goodwill ($17.5M), majority interest was disposed January 2014 (40% retained), and Patch was among brands shuttered/disposed in 2014 with associated long-lived-asset impairments and headcount reductions. p5_pathway=0 because the slice records no fracture at the process/organization interface (operations vs people/management/culture); headcount declines are noted only as a cost consequence of the Patch shutdown, not as an organizational integration break.

openai.performance_metric: $17.5M full Patch goodwill impairment, followed by majority-interest disposition
openai.rationale: The FY2014 10-K documents that Patch's goodwill was fully impaired by a $17.5 million charge in Q3 2013, followed by disposition of a majority interest in January 2014 and its inclusion among brands shuttered or disposed of during 2014. This realized sequence supports product/process-interface disruption (p4). The slice documents no fracture between operations and people, management, or culture, so p5 is coded 0.
